news.titleEn: Iran Says Deal With Oman on Strait of Hormuz Agreed in Principle
news.conclusionEn: Iran and Oman agreed in principle on coordinates for a proposed safe shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, a step toward easing the crisis that has disrupted global oil shipping since the Iran war.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗与阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡安全航道原则性达成一致。
news.whyEn: The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of the world's oil supply; any resolution to the shipping crisis directly affects oil prices, shipping insurance and global trade costs.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡承载全球约五分之一石油运输，航运危机的进展直接影响油价与全球贸易成本。
news.detailEn: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran and Muscat have agreed on the geographical coordinates of a proposed safe shipping route through the strait after more than three weeks of negotiations, along with a joint coordination center to manage maritime traffic. The framework also includes a proposed service fee to be split between Iran and Oman. Iran has dropped its earlier demand for full control over shipping in both directions, but officials cautioned the Iran-Oman agreement alone would not automatically reopen the waterway to normal traffic, since the US and other stakeholders are also involved in the broader negotiations. The strait has seen sharply reduced shipping since the US-Iran conflict escalated earlier this year.
news.detailZh: 伊朗副外长加里巴巴迪表示，经过三周多的谈判，德黑兰与马斯喀特已就海峡内一条拟议安全航道的地理坐标达成一致，双方还计划设立联合协调中心管理海上交通。该框架还包括一项拟议的「服务费」，收入将由伊朗与阿曼分成。伊朗已放弃此前要求对海峡双向航运拥有全面控制权的立场，但官员提醒，仅伊阿两国间的协议并不能自动令海峡恢复正常通航，因为美国等其他相关方也参与更广泛的谈判。自今年早些时候美伊冲突升级以来，该海峡航运量已大幅减少。

news.titleEn: The July Jobs Numbers Are Due Out Friday. Here's What to Expect
news.conclusionEn: Wall Street expects Friday's July jobs report to show payrolls rebounding to around 83,000 with unemployment holding at 4.2%, after June's reading came in at a soft 57,000.
news.conclusionZh: 华尔街预期周五公布的7月就业报告新增约8.3万人，失业率维持4.2%。
news.whyEn: The jobs report is the week's highest-impact economic release and will shape expectations for Fed policy and market direction across stocks, bonds and the dollar.
news.whyZh: 就业报告是本周最重磅经济数据，将左右市场对美联储政策及股汇债走势的预期。
news.detailEn: Economists polled expect nonfarm payrolls to rise by roughly 80,000 to 88,000 in July, a pickup from June's weak 57,000 gain, with the unemployment rate seen holding steady at 4.2%. Investors are watching average hourly earnings closely for wage-inflation signals, given the elevated inflation backdrop this year. The report lands as the S&P 500 and Dow have wobbled this week amid renewed geopolitical tension, and a stronger- or weaker-than-expected print could drive outsized moves in Treasury yields and rate-cut expectations heading into the Fed's Jackson Hole retreat later this month.
news.detailZh: 经济学家调查预计7月非农就业将新增约8万至8.8万人，较6月疲软的5.7万人有所回升，失业率预计维持在4.2%。鉴于今年通胀压力上升，投资者也在密切关注平均时薪数据以判断工资推动型通胀信号。该报告发布之际，标普500与道指本周因地缘局势再度紧张而震荡，数据若明显偏离预期，可能在美联储本月晚些时候召开杰克逊霍尔年会前，引发美债收益率及降息预期的大幅波动。

news.titleEn: Ebola Disease Caused by Bundibugyo Virus – Democratic Republic of the Congo
news.conclusionEn: The WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, making it the country's largest outbreak on record and among the fastest-spreading in history.
news.conclusionZh: 世卫组织称刚果东部埃博拉疫情已致3973例确诊、1801人死亡，为该国史上最大规模疫情。
news.whyEn: A rapidly growing outbreak of one of the deadliest known viruses raises the risk of cross-border spread and could strain international health resources and neighboring economies.
news.whyZh: 疫情快速扩散提高跨境传播风险，或加重国际公共卫生资源及周边国家经济负担。
news.detailEn: As of August 5, the WHO reported 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in DR Congo, with 99 new cases and 52 deaths added in a single day. Ituri province remains hardest hit with roughly 3,460 cases, followed by North Kivu. Health officials describe it as the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record, now surpassing the country's 2018-2020 outbreak, which was previously its largest. The response faces compounding challenges including attacks on healthcare workers by armed groups, public distrust and reliance on traditional healers in remote areas, while there is no vaccine approved specifically for this viral strain.
news.detailZh: 截至8月5日，世卫组织报告刚果境内Bundibugyo毒株埃博拉疫情已累计确诊3973例、死亡1801例，单日新增99例确诊、52例死亡。伊图里省疫情最为严重，约占3460例，北基伍省紧随其后。卫生官员称这是有记录以来蔓延速度最快的埃博拉疫情，已超过该国此前最大规模的2018至2020年疫情。应对工作面临多重挑战，包括武装团体袭击医护人员、公众不信任，以及偏远地区居民依赖传统治疗方式，而针对该病毒株目前尚无获批疫苗。

news.titleEn: Demis Hassabis Steps Down as Google DeepMind CEO Amid Major AI Leadership Shake-Up
news.conclusionEn: Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind to become chairman and Alphabet's chief scientist, while CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over daily operations, as longtime Google chief scientist Jeff Dean also departs to launch his own AI startup.
news.conclusionZh: Hassabis卸任DeepMind CEO转任董事长兼首席科学家，Google AI高层大洗牌。
news.whyEn: The reshuffle at one of the world's leading AI labs signals internal pressure at Google to speed up product delivery as it competes with OpenAI and Anthropic, and moved Alphabet's stock on the news.
news.whyZh: 全球顶尖AI实验室的高层变动，反映Google在与OpenAI、Anthropic竞争中加快交付产品的压力，消息公布后股价随之波动。
news.detailEn: Hassabis will focus on long-term AGI strategy and spend more time at Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet's AI drug-discovery unit, while Koray Kavukcuoglu becomes senior vice president overseeing day-to-day operations and Gemini model development, reporting to CEO Sundar Pichai. Separately, Jeff Dean, a 27-year Google veteran and the company's chief scientist, is leaving to start an independent AI research venture called Discovery Loop, in which Alphabet will be a founding investor and cloud provider. The changes follow a stretch of delayed product launches, including a missed deadline for Gemini 3.5 Pro, and recent talent departures to rival AI labs. Alphabet shares fell roughly 5% after the announcement.
news.detailZh: Hassabis此后将专注于通用人工智能（AGI）长期战略，并把更多精力投入Alphabet旗下AI药物研发部门Isomorphic Labs；现任首席技术官Koray Kavukcuoglu将升任高级副总裁，负责日常运营及Gemini模型开发，直接向CEO劈柴（Sundar Pichai）汇报。另外，在Google任职27年的首席科学家Jeff Dean也将离职，创立独立AI研究机构Discovery Loop，Alphabet将作为创始投资方及云服务提供商参与其中。此次调整正值Google产品交付一再延迟——包括Gemini 3.5 Pro错过发布期限——以及近期人才流向竞争对手AI实验室之际。消息公布后Alphabet股价下跌约5%。

news.titleEn: Uganda Approves Sending Troops for International Force in Gaza
news.conclusionEn: Uganda's parliament approved deploying troops to Gaza as part of a US-backed multinational stabilization force under President Trump's ceasefire plan, joining Morocco in pledging forces.
news.conclusionZh: 乌干达议会批准向加沙派兵，加入摩洛哥参与特朗普加沙停火计划下的多国稳定部队。
news.whyEn: Assembling an international force is a key step toward implementing the Gaza ceasefire plan, and troop commitments from multiple countries signal growing international buy-in despite unresolved questions about the force's mandate and timeline.
news.whyZh: 组建国际部队是落实加沙停火计划的关键一步，多国承诺出兵显示国际社会参与度上升，但部队职责与时间表仍待明确。
news.detailEn: Uganda's parliament voted Thursday to approve military deployment to Gaza if needed as part of the International Stabilization Force proposed under the US-brokered ceasefire framework. Uganda's defense minister told lawmakers that President Trump had personally reached out to President Yoweri Museveni in July seeking Uganda's participation. The force is envisioned to deploy in areas of Gaza not under Israeli control, though it remains unclear when it will actually deploy or under what rules of engagement. Uganda has extensive experience in international peacekeeping, with troops currently serving in Somalia, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
news.detailZh: 乌干达议会周四投票批准，必要时向加沙派遣军队，加入美国斡旋停火框架下拟议组建的「国际稳定部队」。乌干达国防部长向议员表示，特朗普总统7月曾亲自联系乌干达总统穆塞韦尼，寻求乌方参与。该部队计划部署在加沙境内非以色列控制区域，但具体部署时间及交战规则仍不明确。乌干达在国际维和方面经验丰富，目前已有部队在索马里、南苏丹及刚果民主共和国执行任务。

news.titleEn: Airbnb Beats Q2 Estimates, Lifts 2026 Outlook on Strong Travel Demand, Shares Up
news.conclusionEn: Airbnb posted second-quarter revenue of $3.61 billion and adjusted EPS of $1.37, both above Wall Street estimates, and raised its full-year 2026 guidance, sending shares up more than 10% in after-hours trading.
news.conclusionZh: Airbnb二季度营收及每股收益均超预期并上调全年指引，盘后股价大涨逾10%。
news.whyEn: A resilient travel and bookings beat from one of the largest consumer platforms suggests discretionary consumer spending remains solid despite broader economic and geopolitical uncertainty.
news.whyZh: 主要消费平台预订数据强劲，显示消费者可选支出在经济与地缘不确定性下仍具韧性。
news.detailEn: Airbnb's revenue rose 17% year-over-year to $3.61 billion, above the $3.58 billion analysts expected, while gross booking value climbed to $27.2 billion and nights and seats booked grew 10% to 148.3 million. Net income rose to $816 million from $642 million a year earlier. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to at least mid-teens percentage growth, up from a prior low-to-mid-teens forecast, and lifted its adjusted EBITDA margin outlook to at least 35.5%. Shares jumped as much as 12% in after-hours trading following the report.
news.detailZh: Airbnb营收同比增长17%至36.1亿美元，超过分析师预期的35.8亿美元；总预订金额升至272亿美元，间夜及座位预订量同比增长10%至1.483亿。净利润从上年同期的6.42亿美元增至8.16亿美元。公司将2026全年营收增速指引上调至至少「中双位数」百分比（此前为「低至中双位数」），并将调整后EBITDA利润率预期上调至至少35.5%。财报公布后，股价盘后一度上涨12%。

news.titleEn: Payments Firm Fiserv Cuts Annual Profit Forecast, Shares Fall Nearly 12%
news.conclusionEn: Fiserv slashed its 2026 profit and revenue guidance after growth slowed sharply in its merchant and financial-solutions segments, sending shares down nearly 12% in premarket trading.
news.conclusionZh: 支付巨头Fiserv下调全年利润与营收指引，盘前股价重挫近12%。
news.whyEn: A steep guidance cut at a major payments processor signals softening consumer and merchant transaction activity, and adds to pressure from activist investors pushing for a strategic overhaul.
news.whyZh: 支付巨头大幅下调业绩指引，显示消费与商户交易活动降温，也加剧激进投资者要求变革的压力。
news.detailEn: Fiserv cut its 2026 adjusted earnings-per-share forecast to a range of $7.20 to $7.40, down from $8.00 to $8.30, and now expects full-year organic revenue to be flat to down 1%, versus previous guidance of 1% to 3% growth. The weakness was broad-based: merchant solutions revenue fell 1% and financial solutions revenue dropped 8% in the second quarter. The stock, already down roughly 20% this year after a nearly 68% plunge in 2025, has drawn pressure from activist investor Jana Partners, which is pushing Fiserv to conduct a full strategic portfolio review and refresh its board.
news.detailZh: Fiserv将2026年调整后每股收益预期下调至7.20至7.40美元区间（此前为8.00至8.30美元），并预计全年有机营收持平或下降1%，此前预期为增长1%至3%。业绩疲软范围广泛：二季度商户业务营收下降1%，金融业务营收下降8%。该股今年以来已累计下跌约20%，此前2025年更暴跌近68%，激进投资者Jana Partners已向公司施压，要求对整体业务进行战略评估并改组董事会。

news.titleEn: RWE's $1.22B Exit Marks the Latest in Trump's Billion-Dollar Offshore Wind Buyouts—Now Topping $3B to Redirect Developers to Fossil Fuels
news.conclusionEn: German utility RWE agreed to a $1.22 billion settlement with the Trump administration to surrender all its US offshore wind leases, bringing Washington's total offshore-wind buyout spending to roughly $4 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 德国能源巨头RWE以12.2亿美元与特朗普政府达成协议，放弃全部美国海上风电租约。
news.whyEn: The deal marks a major shift of a multinational energy developer away from US offshore wind toward fossil fuels, underscoring how the administration's buyout strategy is reshaping US energy investment away from renewables.
news.whyZh: 该交易标志跨国能源开发商加速撤出美国海上风电、转向化石能源，凸显政府买断策略正重塑美国能源投资方向。
news.detailEn: RWE will surrender its offshore wind leases in New York, California and Louisiana in exchange for the settlement, after federal courts blocked the administration's earlier attempts to directly halt the sector via executive order, prompting a shift to buyouts instead. RWE plans to redirect the funds: $900 million toward a 16% stake in Woodside Energy's Louisiana LNG project, and another $300 million into gas-fired power turbines. The deal follows similar buyouts of wind leases from TotalEnergies, Invenergy, Ocean Winds and others, and RWE says it now holds no remaining US offshore wind leases, citing insurmountable permitting barriers.
news.detailZh: 根据协议，RWE将放弃其在纽约、加利福尼亚及路易斯安那州的海上风电租约；此前联邦法院曾阻止政府通过行政令直接叫停该行业，促使政府转而采取买断策略。RWE计划将所获资金中的9亿美元用于收购Woodside Energy路易斯安那LNG项目16%的股权，另外3亿美元投资于燃气发电涡轮机项目。此前，法国道达尔能源、Invenergy、Ocean Winds等公司也曾获得类似的风电租约买断。RWE表示，由于面临难以逾越的许可障碍，公司目前已不再持有任何美国海上风电租约。

businessTips.explanationEn: Economies of scale describe the cost advantage a company gains as production volume increases, because fixed costs get spread across more units and firms can negotiate better rates with suppliers. This is why large companies can often price lower than smaller rivals while maintaining similar or better margins. But scale also has limits — beyond a certain size, coordination costs and complexity can start eroding those savings, a phenomenon known as diseconomies of scale.
businessTips.explanationZh: 规模经济是指企业随着生产规模扩大而获得的成本优势——固定成本被分摊到更多产品上，企业也能与供应商谈到更优惠的价格。这就是为什么大公司往往能以更低价格销售，同时维持相近甚至更高的利润率。但规模效应也有上限，超过一定规模后，协调成本与管理复杂度上升，反而会侵蚀这些节省，这种现象称为「规模不经济」。
businessTips.exampleEn: A coffee roaster buying 500kg of beans a month pays a much higher per-kilogram price than a national chain buying 500 tons, because the chain's massive order volume lets it negotiate deep supplier discounts and spread its roasting equipment costs across far more product.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家每月采购500公斤咖啡豆的小型烘焙商，其每公斤价格远高于每月采购500吨的连锁企业——因为后者庞大的采购量能换来更大的供应商折扣，烘焙设备的成本也能分摊到远多得多的产品上。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building and growing a business using only personal savings, early revenue and reinvested profits, without raising outside investment. It forces founders to reach profitability faster and keeps full ownership and control, but it also limits how fast a business can scale compared with a well-funded, venture-backed competitor. Many successful side businesses and small companies bootstrap by design, since staying lean lowers the pressure to grow at all costs.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「自筹自建」（Bootstrapping）指完全依靠个人积蓄、早期营收及利润再投入来创业和发展，不引入外部融资。这迫使创始人更快实现盈利，并保留全部所有权与控制权，但相比获得大量融资的竞争对手，扩张速度也会受限。许多成功的副业和小型企业都刻意选择自筹自建，因为保持精简能降低「不惜代价追求增长」的压力。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance graphic designer starts selling digital templates on the side, reinvesting every dollar of profit into better design tools and small ad tests instead of seeking outside funding, and grows the side business into a full income stream over two years purely from its own earnings.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一名自由平面设计师利用业余时间开始销售数字设计模板，将每一分利润都重新投入到更好的设计工具和小额广告测试中，而不是寻求外部融资，两年内完全依靠自身营收将副业发展成主要收入来源。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging is an investing strategy of putting a fixed amount of money into an asset at regular intervals, regardless of price, rather than investing a lump sum all at once. Because the fixed amount buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, it smooths out the average purchase price over time and reduces the risk of investing everything right before a downturn. It doesn't guarantee better returns than lump-sum investing, but it's a simple way to reduce timing risk and emotional decision-making.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（美元成本平均法）是一种投资策略：按固定金额、固定周期投入某项资产，无论价格高低，而非一次性投入全部资金。由于固定金额在价格低时能买到更多份额，价格高时买到更少，长期下来能平滑平均买入成本，降低在下跌前一次性满仓的风险。定投并不保证比一次性投入获得更高回报，但它是降低择时风险和情绪化决策的简单方法。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of investing a $12,000 bonus into an index fund all at once, an investor spreads it into 12 equal monthly purchases of $1,000, so that market swings during the year — like this week's volatility around the jobs report — average out rather than concentrating all the risk on a single day's price.
businessTips.exampleZh: 与其把1.2万美元的奖金一次性投入指数基金，投资者选择分12个月、每月定投1000美元，这样一年中的市场波动——比如本周围绕就业报告的震荡——会被平均化，而不是把所有风险集中在某一天的价格上。
